Variable scope tests: test creates test data variables (e.g. example_data, gs), always use local variables throughout test. Never mix local global variables different scopes. Avoid code outside test blocks: place code outside test_that() blocks (except shared setup data required every test file). Default: NULL. bwMtd character Bandwidth selector: "nrd0", "sj", "hpi0", "hpi1", "hpi2", "hpi3", "Norm" suffix background normalisation. Ignored fixed bw. Default: "hpi1". bwScope character Scalar bandwidth sharing: "cytokine" uses 10% trimmed mean 100 tubes spread across batches; "cluster" groups tube densities right shoulder background modal complex uses cluster medians 100 tubes (least one per cluster); "sample" estimates stimulated/control pair separately. Smaller datasets use tubes. Shared estimates exclude tubes minCell. pair uses smaller tube bandwidth. Inspect bwShared , clusters, bwSharedTbl stimgateMetaReadSettingsChnls(). Ignored fixed bw adaptive bandwidths. Default: "cytokine". bwAdj numeric Bandwidth multiplier; ignored fixed bw. Default: 1. bwMin numeric character Lower bandwidth limit: "auto" estimates , "none" disables , supply number. Ignored fixed bw; estimation failures use bwFallback. Default: "auto". bwMax numeric character Upper bandwidth limit: "auto" estimates , "none" disables , supply number. Ignored fixed bw; estimation failures use bwFallback. Default: "auto". bwFallback numeric character Bandwidth automatic estimation fails: "auto" estimates spread-samples using bwMtd, supply one finite positive number. NULL "none" invalid. Default: "auto". bwNcellMin numeric Minimum selector sample size. Ordinary methods upsample jitter; scalar "Norm" methods use selecting background-core right-excess cells. Ignored fixed bw. Default: 100. bwNcellMax numeric Maximum selector sample size. Ordinary methods downsample; scalar "Norm" methods cap constructed sample inspecting full distribution. Adaptive methods use normAdaptiveNcell. Ignored fixed bw. Default: 100000. bwCluster numeric NULL Density bandwidth threshold clustering. NULL uses shared local-FDR bandwidth, bwScope = "sample", median bandwidth samples direct thresholds. Default: NULL. clusterGates logical Share thresholds across clusters paired stimulated/control densities common expression grid. least three direct thresholds, clip cluster's 15th 85th percentiles.
